shipping.title: Delivery Policy
shipping.lead: How we process, pack and deliver your order, and what to do if something goes wrong on the way.
shipping.body:
This Delivery Policy explains how {store} handles orders placed on this website, from the moment you check out to the moment your parcel arrives.

## Order processing

Once you place an order, you will see an order confirmation, and we begin preparing it for dispatch. Processing includes checking your order details, confirming payment and carefully packing your products.

- Orders are processed on working days.
- If any item in your order is unavailable, we will contact you before dispatching the rest.
- We may contact you to verify order details before dispatch.

## Shipping and delivery process

1. You place your order and receive an order confirmation.
2. We prepare, check and pack your products.
3. Your parcel is handed to our delivery partner.
4. The parcel is delivered to the address you gave at checkout.

## Delivery coverage

We deliver to serviceable addresses across India. Whether we can deliver to your address is checked when you enter it at checkout. If we are unable to deliver to your location, we will let you know and will not take payment for an order we cannot fulfil.

## Estimated delivery

Delivery times depend on your location, the products you order and our delivery partner's schedule.

> Delivery estimates are not fixed promises. If you need an item by a particular date, please contact our support team before ordering so we can tell you what is realistic for your address.

## Shipping charges

Any shipping charge that applies to your order is shown at checkout before you pay. You will always see the full amount, including delivery, before you confirm your order.

## Order tracking

You can follow the status of your order from your account under My Orders. If you checked out as a guest, or tracking details are not yet available, contact our support team with your order number and we will update you.

## Delayed or unsuccessful deliveries

+ Delays: Weather, local restrictions, holidays and other events outside our control can slow a delivery. We will keep you informed if your order is delayed.
+ Failed delivery: If a delivery cannot be completed because the address is incomplete or nobody is available, our delivery partner may try again or return the parcel to us.
+ Address changes: Contact us as soon as possible if you need to change your address. Changes are only possible before the order has been dispatched.
+ Returned parcels: If a parcel comes back to us, we will contact you to arrange a re-delivery or to discuss next steps.

## Damaged package reporting

Please check your parcel when it arrives. If the outer packaging looks damaged, tampered with or opened, note it with the delivery agent if you can, and take photos of the parcel and its contents.

> Report damaged or tampered parcels to our support team as soon as possible after delivery, with your order number and photos, so we can investigate and help you quickly.

## Customer support

For any question about the delivery of your order, contact our support team using the details at the end of this page. Please keep your order number ready.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What information we collect when you shop with us, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacy.body:
Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how {store} collects, uses and protects information when you visit this website or place an order. By using this website, you agree to the practices described here.

## Information we collect

We collect information you give us directly and some information automatically when you use the website.

+ Information you provide: Details you enter when you create an account, place an order, subscribe to updates or contact us.
+ Information collected automatically: Technical information such as your device type, browser and the pages you visit, collected through cookies and similar tools.

## Personal information

The personal information we collect may include:

- Your name
- Email address and phone number
- Delivery and billing addresses
- Account login details
- Messages you send to our support team

## Order and payment information

When you place an order, we keep a record of the products you bought, the amount paid and your delivery details. Payments are handled by our payment service providers. We do not store your full card details on this website.

## How we use your information

- To process, deliver and support your orders
- To manage your account and wishlist
- To answer your questions and requests
- To send order updates and, if you agree, news and offers
- To improve our website, products and service
- To prevent fraud and keep the website secure
- To meet our legal obligations

## Cookies and website analytics

We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your cart, understand how the website is used and improve your experience. Where required, we ask for your consent before using non-essential cookies, and you can change your choice at any time. You can also control cookies through your browser settings, although some parts of the website may not work properly without them.

## Information sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only where needed to run our business and serve you:

- With delivery partners, to deliver your orders
- With payment providers, to process your payments
- With service providers who host and operate this website
- Where required by law or to protect our rights and our customers

## Data security

We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect your information from unauthorised access, loss or misuse. No method of transmitting or storing data online is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Please keep your account password private.

## Data retention

We keep personal information only for as long as we need it for the purposes described in this policy, including keeping records of orders and meeting legal, tax and accounting requirements.

## Your rights

Depending on applicable law, you may ask us to:

- Access the personal information we hold about you
- Correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete
- Delete your information, where we are not required to keep it
- Stop sending you marketing messages

You can update most account details yourself in My Account. For any other request, contact us using the details at the end of this page.

## Third-party services

This website may use third-party services such as payment providers, delivery partners and analytics tools. These services handle information under their own privacy policies. Links to other websites are provided for convenience, and we are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

## Policy updates

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and continuing to use the website after an update means you accept the revised policy.

## Contact information

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, contact our support team using the email or phone number at the end of this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you browse this website, create an account or place an order with us.
terms.body:
Welcome to {store}. These Terms & Conditions govern your use of this website and any purchase you make through it. Please read them carefully.

## Acceptance of terms

By accessing this website or placing an order, you agree to these Terms & Conditions and to our other policies, including our Privacy Policy, Delivery Policy, Return and Refund Policy, Billing Terms and Cancellation Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

## Website usage

You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes. You must not:

- Use the website in any way that breaks the law
- Attempt to gain unauthorised access to the website or its systems
- Interfere with the website's operation or security
- Copy or use the website's content for commercial purposes without permission

## Account registration

You may need an account to use some features, such as order history and wishlists. You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential and for all activity under your account. Please give accurate information and keep it up to date. We may suspend accounts that are misused.

## Product information

We try to describe and display our products as accurately as possible. Colours, sizes and appearance may vary slightly because of screen settings and manufacturer updates. Product specifications are provided as given by the manufacturer or supplier.

## Product pricing

Prices are shown on each product page and in your cart. We may change prices at any time without notice, but a change will not affect an order that has already been confirmed. If a product is listed at an incorrect price because of an error, we may cancel the order and refund any amount paid.

## Orders and acceptance

Placing an order is an offer to buy. An order is accepted when it is confirmed and processed for dispatch. We may decline or cancel an order, for example when a product is unavailable, there is a pricing error or we suspect fraud. If we cancel an order you have paid for, you will receive a refund.

## Payment terms

Payment must be completed using one of the payment methods offered at checkout. You confirm that you are authorised to use the payment method you choose. Please see our Billing Terms and Conditions for more information.

## Shipping and delivery

Orders are delivered as described in our Delivery Policy. Delivery estimates are approximate and may be affected by events outside our control.

## Returns and refunds

Returns, replacements and refunds are handled under our Return and Refund Policy. Order cancellations are handled under our Cancellation Policy.

## Intellectual property

All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos and images, belongs to {store} or its licensors and is protected by applicable laws. Brand names and trademarks of products sold on this website belong to their respective owners.

## Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, {store} is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of this website or the products purchased through it. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under applicable consumer protection law.

## Changes to terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. The version on this page applies to your use of the website, and to orders placed after it is published.

## Contact information

If you have any questions about these Terms & Conditions, contact our support team using the details at the end of this page.

returns.title: Return and Refund Policy
returns.lead: When a product can be returned, how to request a return, and how refunds are processed.
returns.body:
We want you to be happy with every purchase from {store}. If something is not right with your order, this policy explains how returns, replacements and refunds work.

> A return is for a product you have already received. To stop an order before it reaches you, please see our Cancellation Policy instead.

## Return eligibility

A product may be eligible for return or replacement when:

- It arrived damaged or defective
- You received the wrong product, size or colour
- It is materially different from its description on our website

> The return window that applies to each product is confirmed by our support team. Please contact us as soon as possible after delivery, and before sending anything back, so we can confirm whether your product is eligible.

## Eligible and non-eligible products

+ Usually eligible: Products that are damaged, defective or incorrect on arrival, returned complete with their original packaging, accessories and documentation.
+ Usually not eligible: Products that have been used, damaged after delivery, altered or installed, items with missing parts or packaging, and items marked as non-returnable on their product page.

## Product condition requirements

To be accepted, a returned product must be:

- In the condition it was delivered in
- Returned with all accessories, manuals, free items and tags
- Packed securely in its original box, where possible
- Free of any personal data, accounts or passwords on electronic devices

## Damaged or defective products

If your product arrives damaged or stops working because of a manufacturing defect, contact our support team with your order number, a description of the problem and clear photos or a short video. Some products are covered by a manufacturer's warranty, and we may guide you to the brand's authorised service centre where that is the fastest way to resolve the issue.

## Incorrect products received

If you receive a product that is different from what you ordered, please do not use it. Contact us with your order number and photos of the product and its label, and we will arrange a replacement or refund.

## Return request process

1. Contact our support team with your order number and the reason for the return.
2. Share photos or a video of the product and its packaging if we ask for them.
3. Our team reviews your request and confirms whether it is approved.
4. If approved, we will explain how to send the product back or arrange a pickup where available.
5. Once we receive and inspect the product, we process your replacement or refund.

## Refund approval

A refund is approved after the returned product is received and inspected. If a return does not meet the conditions in this policy, we may decline it and send the product back to you.

## Refund processing

Approved refunds are sent back to the original payment method. The time it takes for the amount to appear in your account depends on your bank or payment provider.

> Refund timelines can vary by payment method. Our support team will confirm the expected timeline when your refund is approved.

## Payment reversal

For online payments, the refunded amount is reversed to the same card, account or wallet you used to pay. If the original payment method is no longer available, contact us and we will help you find another way to receive your refund.

## Exchange information

Where an exchange is possible, we will replace a damaged, defective or incorrect product with the same item. If a replacement is not available, we will offer a refund instead.

## Customer support

For any question about a return or refund, contact our support team using the details at the end of this page. Please keep your order number ready.

billing.title: Billing Terms and Conditions
billing.lead: How prices, taxes, payments and invoices work for orders placed on this website.
billing.body:
These Billing Terms and Conditions explain how {store} charges for orders placed on this website. They form part of our Terms & Conditions.

## Product pricing

The price of each product is shown on its product page and in your cart. The final amount you pay is shown in the order summary at checkout before you confirm. Prices may change from time to time, but the price confirmed in your order is the price you pay.

## Applicable taxes

Taxes are applied according to applicable law. The order summary at checkout shows how taxes are reflected in the amount you pay.

## Billing information

Please enter accurate billing details, including your name, billing address and contact information. These details are used to process your payment and to prepare your invoice.

## Payment methods

The payment methods available for your order are shown at checkout. Only the methods offered there can be used to pay. Payments are processed securely by our payment service providers.

## Order confirmation

After your payment is successful, you will see an order confirmation. You can view your orders at any time under My Orders in your account.

## Invoice generation

An invoice is issued for each completed order. If you need a copy of your invoice, contact our support team with your order number.

## Payment failures

A payment can fail because of incorrect details, insufficient funds or a problem with your bank or payment provider. If your payment fails, your order will not be confirmed.

> If money was deducted but you did not receive an order confirmation, please contact our support team with your payment details. Such amounts are usually reversed by your bank or payment provider.

## Refund adjustments

If an order is cancelled, returned or partly fulfilled, any refund due is calculated on the amount you actually paid for the affected products and is sent back to the original payment method, as described in our Return and Refund Policy and Cancellation Policy.

## Billing disputes

If you believe you have been charged incorrectly, contact our support team first with your order number and payment details. We will review the charge and work with you to resolve it.

## Customer responsibilities

- Give accurate billing and contact information
- Use only payment methods you are authorised to use
- Check your order summary carefully before paying
- Keep your order number and payment reference for your records

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.lead: When and how you can cancel an order, and how refunds work for cancelled orders.
cancellation.body:
This Cancellation Policy explains how you can cancel an order placed with {store}, and when we may cancel an order ourselves.

+ Cancellation: Stopping an order before it is delivered to you. This page covers cancellations.
+ Return: Sending back a product after you have received it. Returns are covered by our Return and Refund Policy.

## Order cancellation eligibility

You can request to cancel an order as long as it has not yet been dispatched. Once an order has been handed to our delivery partner, it can no longer be cancelled through this policy.

## How to request a cancellation

1. Contact our support team as soon as possible using the details at the end of this page.
2. Share your order number and the reason for cancelling.
3. Our team checks the status of your order.
4. We confirm whether your cancellation has been accepted.

## Cancellation before order processing

If your order has not yet been processed or dispatched, we will cancel it and refund any amount you have paid.

## Cancellation after shipment

Once your order has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled. You may refuse the delivery or, after receiving the product, request a return if it qualifies under our Return and Refund Policy.

> Whether a refused or returned delivery qualifies for a refund, and any charges that apply, are confirmed by our support team. Please contact us before refusing a delivery.

## Seller-initiated cancellation

We may cancel an order, in full or in part, in situations such as:

- The product is unavailable
- There is an error in the product's price or description
- We cannot deliver to the address provided
- Payment could not be confirmed
- We suspect fraudulent or unauthorised activity

If we cancel your order, we will let you know, and any amount you have paid will be refunded.

## Payment refunds for cancelled orders

For an approved cancellation of a paid order, the amount is refunded to the original payment method. The time it takes to appear in your account depends on your bank or payment provider.

## Non-cancellable orders

Some products may not be cancellable once ordered, for example items prepared or configured specially for you. Where this applies, it will be stated on the product page or confirmed by our support team.

## Refund communication

We will confirm your cancellation and keep you informed about your refund. If you have not received a refund you expected, contact our support team with your order number.

## Customer support

For help with cancelling an order, contact our support team using the details at the end of this page. Please keep your order number ready.
